text: Mrs. Straker's account: one o'clock and seven o'clock
why: The story says only that Mrs. Straker woke at one in the morning. The seven o'clock time appears nowhere in the story so far.
Paragraph 32 says Straker pulled on his large mackintosh before leaving the house.
The events happened on Monday night (paragraph 19 and 'last Monday night'), so one in the morning falls on Tuesday.

text: Why did Straker go out at one in the morning?
why: A plain question the story has just raised, and paragraph 32 gives Straker's stated reason.

text: Why did Straker go out at one in the morning? — to see that all was well
id: q.straker_aim=to see that all was well
why: Paragraph 32 states that Straker said he intended to walk down to the stables to see that all was well.
